audit_member_text: Copy/paste defect: the file header says 'TIDE_MODULE ... add tide/surge boundary conditions' at L46, while the implemented entity is SUBGRID_MODULE at L52 and all procedures implement subgrid bathymetry/porosity.

base_member_text: SubMainGridRatio @L89-100: when absent from input.txt the log claims 'use 1 for default' (L93) but no assignment SubMainGridRatio=1 exists, leaving it undefined before NumPixel= @L104 and ALLOCATE @L109
audit_member_text: Use-before-assignment/default-path defect: SubMainGridRatio is declared without initialization at L62, READ_INTEGER is called at L89, and ierr==1 only emits 'use 1 for default' at L90-L100; no SubMainGridRatio=1 assignment occurs before NumPixel and allocation extents use it at L104-L109. Correctness depends on undocumented mutation by READ_INTEGER even on failure.

base_member_text: Cross-line index inconsistency between GetFile_SubGrid branches: serial stores at ghost-offset (Ix+Nghost,Iy+Nghost) @L330,L333 while parallel stores at (Ix,Iy) into global arrays @L257,L260 that are later mapped through GLOB_to_LOC which applies the Nghost shift @L368 - net alignment differs if Ix,Iy are 1-based interior indices
UPDATE_SUBGRID updates DepAvgSubgrid/Porosity but never DepMaxSubgrid; initial pass uses still-water DepSubGrid>0 (L160) while update uses Eta+DepSubGrid>0 (L203-204)
GLOB_to_LOC rank 0 self-block PHI=PHIGLOB(1:Mloc,1:Nloc) @L408 assumes rank 0 subdomain starts at global origin (Nistas(1)=1)

rMASKS allocated @L106-108 but never used; unused declarations: AvgEta,TmpEta,tmpv3,tmpv4 @L60, Ktmp,tmpk1,tmpk2,pcount1,pcount2 @L61, LINE @L69, l @L235/L308, Ifile @L83, TMP_NAME only used for porosity.ini @L186
OUT_POROSITY is read with input keyword 'Porosity' @L102 (name differs from variable), and READ_STRING for DEPTH_FILE @L113 duplicates the read done in init.F (comment @L140 acknowledges repetition)
Dry-point convention: Porosity set to 1.0 where <SMALL (L180, L223), so fully-dry cells carry porosity 1 downstream by design for etauv_solver
Commented debug block @L291-297 (tmp0.txt); PHIGLOB in GLOB_to_LOC @L351 is a fixed-size automatic array defined on all ranks but only filled on myid 0 @L365-388

audit_member_text: Range defect: no check enforces SubMainGridRatio>0 before NumPixel is formed at L104, dimensions are allocated at L106-L109, and division by REAL(NumPixel) occurs at L171-L172 and L213-L214. Zero or negative input can therefore create invalid/zero extents and division by zero.

Range defect: sparse-file Ix/Iy are used directly as PHIGLOB(Ix,Iy,...) at L257-L261 in the parallel path and as Ix+Nghost/Iy+Nghost at L330-L334 in the serial path, with no bounds validation against global or local array extents.

MPI cross-line size/rank assumption: gather destination arrays are allocated with nprocs entries at L396, but the send loop is bounded by px*py at L411 and indexes the gathered arrays with irank+1 at L413-L416. No local check establishes px*py==nprocs; a mismatch can overrun bounds or address nonexistent ranks.
